title: A process tree
description:
Model processes with parents, and end a whole tree the way a job object does.

```
editor (1)
  compiler (2)
    linker (4)
  formatter (3)
kill tree of 2 -> ended 4, 2
editor still running with 1 child
```
hints: A post-order walk (children first) gives the order to end them (lesson 1.03).
Ending a job ends every process with that job id, whatever its parent.
requirements: Processes have an id, a name and a parent id; print the tree.
`killTree(id)` ends children before parents and returns the order.
A process whose parent has ended is still in the list (Windows does not end children automatically), unless it is in the same "job".
stretch: Add job limits: refuse to start a new process in a job that already has 3.
